text.text_excerpt: This is a new restaurant in the Broodmoor /Claiborne area that I had to check out and I was glad I did. This is more of a call in for takeout restaurant that has limited seating so I do not recommend dining in. I called in an order on a Wednesday which was their Steak Night and I picked up my order 20 minutes later with no problems. For $14 each I was able to purchase a steak, a side salad, corn, mashed potatoes and bread. Once I got home and served the steaks on dinner plates I was very impressed with the generous size of the steaks and how each was cooked medium the way we wanted. People if you are anywhere near this place you need to visit here. This is a hidden gem and so satisfying and the price is amazing. Owned by 4 brothers who have previously worked in the restaurant industry. It was worth every penny spent. We tried the seafood nachos and the BBQ shrimp Po-Boy. The nachos were AMAZING. I had to get the cheese sauce to take home. I am a nacho lover and these were great. Small container, more like an appetizer size but so good. Reading the menu I wanted several items but went with the recommendation of the Po-Boy. It was good but the sauce was definitely different than most BBQ sauces I have tasted, it was unique and tasty. Ok I'll admit it. It may be cliche' but I did it. I ordered their red beans and rice with hot sausage on a Monday and I have to say it was delicious. The beans had a nice flavor and added ham hock and sausage gave it the extra kick. The potato salad is a mustard base and a tangy version of the dish. I chose the sausage option and to my surprise it was several patties and not a link which is what I was expecting. They offered large portions and for a reasonable $10 bucks. I thought it was worth every penny. They have a menu posted on door and above it reads "New Menu" so I am sharing the photo.
